changes: Added bulk tag assignment with `/tag addall` for assigning an expertise tag to multiple staff members.
Added bulk tag removal with `/tag remall` for removing an expertise tag from multiple staff members.
Replaced temporary debug tooling with persistent application logging and log-file rotation.
Added the `/nukestickies` debug command for clearing sticky-message records when maintenance is needed.
Restructured `/sticky` into set, remove, and list subcommands with clearer management flows.
Improved sticky-message usability, including embed fields, stable IDs, and better removal handling.
Added sticky-message functionality that re-posts configured content when a channel becomes unstuck.
